abstract: The April 21, 2025 Potato Axis post preserves an exact logarithmic spiral, r(θ)=a exp(bθ), with b=ln(φ)/(π/2)=2ln(φ)/π≈0.30635. This makes every quarter-turn multiply radius by the golden ratio φ, giving an exact self-similar scale relation rather than a merely decorative spiral motif. The equation is genuine primary project mathematics and matches the Consciousness Spiral already present in the 2024 Great Book. Its geometry is mathematically clear; its physical interpretation remains open because the historical meanings and units of r, θ and a have not yet been recovered. The strongest present use is therefore as a geometric or scale-flow generator and as a testable distinction between circular recurrence and spiral return with changed scale.

reader_takeaway: The recovered spiral is exact logarithmic-spiral mathematics, not merely a symbolic drawing.
